title: session-audit shared definitions
description: Pinned, tolerant copy of session-audit's schemas/defs.json (additionalProperties false relaxed to true). Reads ignore unknown fields. Shared $defs referenced by the other schemas (config.json is self-contained). Fields marked x-untrusted carry transcript or model text.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the configured time zone.

sha256_16.description: First 16 hex characters of a SHA-256.

retro_id.description: ra- followed by 8 lowercase base32 characters.

token.description: A short lowercase word owned by claude-session or this tool.

model.description: A model name copied from a transcript.

ref.description: Session number inside one retro, s1 to s500.

session_tokens.description: Session totals; the four counters are the main agent's only, subagents is the sum of all four counters over the agents.

cost.description: Cost bases are never added into one number. reported_usd is the main file's last cost-state figure, null under copied history; in a row or totals it is all-or-null (see the interface, Counting rules 2).

labels.description: Unauthenticated hints copied from claude-session: key=value strings (a multiset, as claude-session prints them).

harness.description: Snapshot copied from claude-session (refreshed whenever its updated_at changes) and joined to sessions at query time; labels are unauthenticated. cost_usd is claude-session's cost of that run and is never a session's reported cost.

session.description: One session (counts and ids only, no conversation text), derived at query time from counted events and per-file facts. Counters include agents; tokens is the main agent with tokens.subagents separate; cost includes agents. ended_at >= started_at holds by construction; tool_errors may exceed tool_calls (an error whose call sits in a pruned or unread file).

agent.description: A subagent transcript linked to its parent session by the parent's tool-call id.

usage_row.description: Counted events aggregated per (day in time_zone, session, agent or main, model); agent_id null means the main transcript, day null an event with no slot, model null an event with no model.

anyOf.description: As typed: a time, a date or a duration ago.
As typed: a time, a date or a duration ago.

scope.description: Descriptive retro scope (the flags of retro run as given; sessions resolved to full ids, since and until kept as typed; resolved times are in scope_resolved).

coverage.description: Per session: items that existed, items kept and how many were dropped by which cap.

evidence.description: Reference to a digest item id or a metric id of the manifest.

sessions.description: Distinct session refs the supporting findings cite.

stored_candidate.description: A candidate as stored: the model's fields plus tool-written risk and sessions. All text is untrusted.

retro_metrics.description: Metric id to value, computed from the store.

sessions.description: The kept sessions, for mapping evidence refs to sessions.

retro.description: The stored Retro object. key and coverage are set when the row is inserted and are never null. key is computed as in the interface, Retro lifecycle (Key). Untrusted fields: summary, findings[].title and detail, candidates[].target_hint and proposal. counts.findings equals the findings length (tool-enforced).

retro_row.description: One row of retro list: counts, never the findings or any model text.

message.description: A fixed string of the tool; never transcript, model or input text.

field.description: The config key, flag or environment variable at fault, never its value.

details.description: Closed set of ids, counts and enums; never a path, a value or transcript or model text.

error.description: Exit mapping: see the interface, Exit codes. Exits 129, 130 and 143 print no envelope.
